FIELD.name: exposure_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Exposure identification number

FIELD.name: plate_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Plate identification number

FIELD.name: archive_id
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Archive identification number

FIELD.name: exposure_num
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Exposure sequence number

FIELD.name: object_name
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Name of the observed object or field

FIELD.name: ra_orig
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Original recorded right ascension of the telescope pointing (plate center)

FIELD.name: dec_orig
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Original recorded declination of the telescope pointing (plate center)

FIELD.name: flag_coord
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Quality flag of the recorded coordinates (right ascension and declination)

FIELD.name: ra_icrs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Right ascension of the source (International Celestial Reference System)

FIELD.name: dec_icrs
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Declination of the source (International Celestial Reference System)

FIELD.name: date_orig_start
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Original recorded date of the sub-exposure (evening date)

FIELD.name: date_orig_end
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Original recorded date of the exposure end (evening date)

FIELD.name: time_orig_start
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Original recorded start time of the sub-exposure

FIELD.name: time_orig_end
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Original recorded end time of the sub-exposure

FIELD.name: flag_time
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Quality flag of the recorded observation time

FIELD.name: ut_start
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UT date and time of the start of exposure

FIELD.name: ut_mid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UT date and time at the mid-point of sub-exposure

FIELD.name: ut_weighted
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UT date and time of the weighted mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: ut_end
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: UT date and time of the sub-exposure end

FIELD.name: year_start
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Decimal Julian year of the start of exposure

FIELD.name: year_mid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Decimal year of the mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: year_weighted
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Decimal Julian year of the weighted mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: year_end
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Decimal Julian year of the end of exposure

FIELD.name: jd_start
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Julian date at the start of exposure

FIELD.name: jd_mid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Julian date at the mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: jd_weighted
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Julian date at the weighted mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: jd_end
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Julian date at the end of sub-exposure

FIELD.name: hjd_mid
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Heliocentric Julian date at the mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: hjd_weighted
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Heliocentric Julian date at the weighted mid-point of exposure

FIELD.name: exptime
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Exposure time

FIELD.name: num_sub
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Number of sub-exposures

FIELD.name: focus
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Focus value (from logbook)

FIELD.name: timestamp_insert
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of insert

FIELD.name: timestamp_update
FIELD.DESCRIPTION: Timestamp of last update
